title: Gift Card Cashback: 3% on Coles & Bunnings + [Westpac, StG, BoM, BSA] 3% Bonus on Coles, 4% Bonus on Bunnings @ ShopBack
body:
Deal: Gift Card Cashback: 3% on Coles & Bunnings + [Westpac, StG, BoM, BSA] 3% Bonus on Coles, 4% Bonus on Bunnings @ ShopBack

[ATangk] Bunnings slightly better than the 6.5% westpac promotion last week.
Can also buy a large gift card, use it once instore to get a physical gift card, then use it online.
[SnoozeAndLose] Do you mean to exchange into a Bunning eGift card, then go in-store to pay for a physical gift card?
[ATangk] Yes, since these are in-store only. But you might need to buy something small, as Bunnings will only refund the balance of the egift card onto a physical gift card. Haven't actually tried directly asking to buy a $500 gift card then paying with the $500 egift card.
[AsukaST] Haven't actually tried directly asking to buy a $500 gift card then paying with the $500 egift card.
I tried, they said no.
They don't let me exchange it.
[ATangk] @AsukaST: I would have preferred it, the new staff always struggle on figuring out the exact amount to put on the gift card.
[littlesoldier] There are 2 versions of Bunnings giftcards, one with 2 barcodes, the other with single barcode and a PIN
The one with 2 barcodes can only be used in store, however once you use "some amount in the giftcard" in store, bunnings staff will now re-issue a new giftcard (single barcode and a PIN), this replacement one can be used both online and instore, and also support checking balance online
Before Bunnings introduce this new version of giftcard, traditionally they will issue another "one-use" giftcard in the nearest $10, then give you cash for the remaining balance (eg. your old giftcard has $69 after redemption, they issue a new $60 giftcard and give back $9 cash to you), very old fashion indeed…
[Averell] Once a staff told me that they will give cash as change if it is less than 5% of the original amount.
Last month I paid $196.xx using a $200 gift card, they gave me a $3.xx gift card (the one with a pin).
There was another occasion when they gave me "store credit", which is a barcode printed on receipt paper. I remember it only had one barcode, no pin. And when I used only part of it, they printed a new barcode
[NotJoking] Not falling for this again, still waiting for Westpac cashback from last deal
[ATangk] 6.5% supershop card right? Got all of mine no issues but bought really early.
[sqheaven] Does Westpac business one card work for this bank promotion? It did not work for me last time, opened a case to get my cashback so it's a headache for 3%
[littlesoldier] According to T&C, business cards are not supported
https://www.westpac.com.au/faq/shopback-eligible-cards/
[TerryTightwad] is there a limit to these? Because family member just bought a whole kitchen in Bunnings so need about $14,000 in gift cards.
[ATangk] Theres a card limit per denomination. ATM its 10 for the $500 card, then youd be able to get 10 of each of the others for 5k, 2.5k, 2k, 1.5k, 1k, $500, $200 and $100, for a grand total of $12.8k.
Then use another account and you will easily reach 14k.
However, there might be a limit of 5 cards once the promotion starts.
